sets.relationshipLabel: tool and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A sickle exists to reap and a rake exists to gather — each tool is defined by the single motion it was built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: category and its specific named instance
sets.explanation: A Harvest Moon is a particular full moon and a Canada goose is a particular migratory bird — each pair moves from the general kind to its named example.

sets.relationshipLabel: the written or spoken form and the outcome it predicts
sets.explanation: An almanac forecasts crop yield just as a weather forecast predicts rainfall — each pair is a document paired unmistakably with the outcome it foretells.

sets.relationshipLabel: the one quality this thing can never carry
sets.explanation: Moonlight can never carry warmth and a shadow can never carry weight — each pair names the single physical property structurally ruled out by what the thing is.
